name: @yoryoboy/bi-mcp

tools.name: meli_search_product_ads_campaigns
tools.description: Search MercadoLibre Product Ads campaigns for one advertiser site and advertiser id over a date range, returning one page with raw campaign rows, continuation metadata, and guidance for drilling into ad groups.

profileId.description: Explicit MercadoLibre profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

siteId.description: Explicit MercadoLibre site id to use for Product Ads. If both siteId and advertiserId are provided, the ads search tool uses them directly. If either one is omitted, the tool can resolve a single available advertiser or return a guided selection payload.

advertiserId.description: Explicit MercadoLibre advertiser id to use for Product Ads. If both siteId and advertiserId are provided, the ads search tool uses them directly. If either one is omitted, the tool can resolve a single available advertiser or return a guided selection payload.

dateFrom.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format for the Product Ads window.

dateTo.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format for the Product Ads window.

tools.name: meta_list_accessible_businesses
tools.description: List Meta businesses accessible with the configured token, useful for onboarding and permission validation.

profileId.description: Active profile ID with Meta mapping to use for this request. If omitted, the tool returns available mapped Meta profiles to choose from.

after.description: Unused in profile-scoped mode. Kept only for compatibility with older prompts.

tools.name: meta_list_accessible_ad_accounts
tools.description: List Meta ad accounts accessible with the configured token, including IDs, currencies, business context, and status.

profileId.description: Active profile ID with Meta mapping to use for this request. If omitted, the tool returns available mapped Meta profiles to choose from.

after.description: Optional numeric cursor returned by a previous scoped Meta ad accounts listing.

tools.name: meta_get_ad_account_info
tools.description: Get summary information for one Meta ad account, including name, currency, timezone, business, and account status.

profileId.description: Active profile ID with Meta mapping to use for this request. If omitted, the tool returns available mapped Meta profiles to choose from.

adAccountId.description: Meta ad account ID to inspect. Accepts digits with or without the act_ prefix.

tools.name: meta_get_account_overview
tools.description: Get a Meta Ads overview for one or more ad accounts over a date range, including spend, clicks, impressions, purchases, purchase value, CPC, CPM, and ROAS.

profileId.description: Active profile ID with Meta mapping to use for this request. If omitted, the tool returns available mapped Meta profiles to choose from.

adAccountIds.description: Optional list of Meta ad account IDs. Accepts digits with or without the act_ prefix. If omitted, uses the mapped selected ad accounts for the chosen profile.

tools.name: meta_get_campaign_performance
tools.description: Get Meta Ads campaign-level performance for one or more ad accounts over a date range with spend, clicks, impressions, purchases, purchase value, CPC, CPM, and ROAS.

profileId.description: Active profile ID with Meta mapping to use for this request. If omitted, the tool returns available mapped Meta profiles to choose from.

adAccountIds.description: Optional list of Meta ad account IDs. Accepts digits with or without the act_ prefix. If omitted, uses the mapped selected ad accounts for the chosen profile.

limit.description: Maximum number of campaigns to return per ad account. Default: 25.

tools.name: meta_get_ads_performance
tools.description: Get Meta Ads ad-level performance for one or more ad accounts over a date range, useful for creative review and performance diagnostics.

profileId.description: Active profile ID with Meta mapping to use for this request. If omitted, the tool returns available mapped Meta profiles to choose from.

adAccountIds.description: Optional list of Meta ad account IDs. Accepts digits with or without the act_ prefix. If omitted, uses the mapped selected ad accounts for the chosen profile.

limit.description: Maximum number of ads to return per ad account. Default: 25.

tools.name: meta_get_time_series
tools.description: Get a Meta Ads time series for one or more ad accounts over a date range, with daily, weekly, or monthly granularity.

profileId.description: Active profile ID with Meta mapping to use for this request. If omitted, the tool returns available mapped Meta profiles to choose from.

adAccountIds.description: Optional list of Meta ad account IDs. Accepts digits with or without the act_ prefix. If omitted, uses the mapped selected ad accounts for the chosen profile.

timeIncrement.description: Time increment for the series. Use 1 for daily, 7 for weekly, or monthly.

tools.name: meta_get_placement_mix
tools.description: Get Meta Ads placement mix for one or more ad accounts over a date range, including publisher platform and platform position performance.

profileId.description: Active profile ID with Meta mapping to use for this request. If omitted, the tool returns available mapped Meta profiles to choose from.

adAccountIds.description: Optional list of Meta ad account IDs. Accepts digits with or without the act_ prefix. If omitted, uses the mapped selected ad accounts for the chosen profile.

tools.name: vtex_get_orders_summary
tools.description: Get aggregated orders summary by date range with currency-aware BI metrics.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

orderBy.description: Sort order in VTEX format, e.g. creationDate,desc

tools.name: vtex_get_order_details
tools.description: Get BI-focused detailed information for one or more orders.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

orderIds.description: List of VTEX order identifiers to fetch (up to 50 IDs)

reason.description: Optional reason for requesting unmasked PII data when required

tools.name: vtex_check_inventory
tools.description: Check global SKU inventory and infer stock health status.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

skuIds.description: List of SKU identifiers to fetch (up to 50 IDs)

tools.name: vtex_get_warehouse_inventory
tools.description: Get SKU inventory details for a specific warehouse.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_update_inventory
tools.description: Update the stock quantity and unlimited-quantity mode for one SKU in one warehouse. This overwrites the current quantity and availability mode stored in VTEX for that warehouse.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

unlimitedQuantity.description: When true, VTEX keeps the SKU available regardless of stock. This overwrites the current unlimited mode for the SKU in the selected warehouse.

dateUtcOnBalanceSystem.description: Optional UTC timestamp for inventory update synchronization

tools.name: vtex_update_lead_time
tools.description: Update the lead time for one SKU in one warehouse. This overwrites the current lead time value in VTEX for that warehouse.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

leadTime.description: Lead time value for the SKU in VTEX expected format (for example `1.00:00:00`). This overwrites the current lead time for the selected warehouse.

tools.name: vtex_toggle_unlimited_quantity
tools.description: Toggle only the unlimited-quantity mode for one SKU in one warehouse. This keeps the current stock quantity and overwrites only the unlimited availability flag.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

unlimitedQuantity.description: New unlimited availability mode for this SKU in the selected warehouse.

tools.name: vtex_update_sku_price
tools.description: Update base pricing fields for one SKU in VTEX Pricing. This can overwrite base price, list price, cost price, markup, and, if fixedPrices is sent, it also replaces any fixed prices not included in the payload.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

skuId.description: SKU item identifier used by VTEX Pricing.

basePrice.description: New base price for the SKU.

costPrice.description: New cost price for the SKU.

markup.description: New markup percentage for the SKU.

listPrice.description: New list price for the SKU.

fixedPrices.description: Optional full fixed price list to persist together with the base price update. VTEX overwrites any existing fixed prices not included here.

tradePolicyId.description: Trade policy or price table identifier for the fixed price.

listPrice.description: Optional list price for the fixed price.

minQuantity.description: Minimum quantity required for this fixed price.

dateRange.description: Optional validity window for the fixed price.

from.description: RFC3339 start timestamp for the fixed price.

to.description: RFC3339 end timestamp for the fixed price.

tools.name: vtex_delete_sku_price
tools.description: Delete all base pricing and fixed prices for one SKU from VTEX Pricing. Before using this tool, the assistant must explain that this removes the SKU price record, mention that all fixed prices under that SKU are removed as well, and obtain explicit confirmation from the user. Only then should the tool be called with confirmed=true.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

skuId.description: SKU item identifier used by VTEX Pricing.

confirmed.description: Set to true only after the assistant has explained the impact of this operation and the user has explicitly confirmed they want to proceed.

confirmationNote.description: Optional note summarizing the user's explicit confirmation in natural language.

tools.name: vtex_upsert_fixed_price
tools.description: Create or replace fixed prices for one SKU inside one price table or trade policy. The provided fixed prices overwrite the current entries for that price table.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

skuId.description: SKU item identifier used by VTEX Pricing.

priceTableId.description: Trade policy or price table identifier.

minQuantity.description: Minimum quantity for the fixed price.

dateRange.description: Optional validity window for this fixed price.

fixedPrices.description: Fixed prices to create or replace inside the selected price table.

tools.name: vtex_delete_fixed_price
tools.description: Delete all fixed prices configured for one SKU inside one price table or trade policy.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

skuId.description: SKU item identifier used by VTEX Pricing.

priceTableId.description: Trade policy or price table identifier to clear.

tools.name: vtex_activate_sku
tools.description: Activate one SKU by setting its active flag to true. This updates the SKU record in VTEX and preserves the current operational fields.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_deactivate_sku
tools.description: Deactivate one SKU by setting its active flag to false. This updates the SKU record in VTEX and preserves the current operational fields.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_update_product_basic_fields
tools.description: Update core product fields such as name, description, category, brand, visibility, and SEO fields. Only the provided fields are changed; the tool keeps the current VTEX values for the rest.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

isVisible.description: Whether the product should remain visible in listings.

isActive.description: Whether the product should remain active.

releaseDate.description: New release date in ISO format.

showWithoutStock.description: Whether the product can stay visible without stock.

tools.name: vtex_update_sku_basic_fields
tools.description: Update core SKU fields such as name, reference, EAN, dimensions, weight, measurement unit, and active flags. Only the provided fields are changed; the tool keeps the current VTEX values for the rest.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

ean.description: New EAN. When informed, existing EAN values are replaced with this one.

commercialConditionId.description: Commercial condition ID. Use vtex_commercial_conditions to inspect available condition IDs and vtex_payment_rules to configure linked installment/payment behavior.

isActive.description: Whether the SKU should remain active.

activateIfPossible.description: Whether VTEX should auto-activate the SKU when possible.

tools.name: vtex_create_product
tools.description: Create one product in VTEX Catalog. You can point it to existing category and brand IDs, or ask VTEX Catalog to use categoryPath and brandName when those entities are not already mapped.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

categoryPath.description: Category path to create or reuse, for example `Mens/Clothing/T-Shirts`.

brandName.description: Brand name to create or reuse when `brandId` is not provided.

releaseDate.description: Product release date in ISO format.

isVisible.description: Whether the product should be visible in listings.

isActive.description: Whether the product should be active.

showWithoutStock.description: Whether the product stays visible without stock.

tools.name: vtex_create_sku
tools.description: Create one SKU under an existing VTEX product. This creates the SKU record and can optionally attach one EAN after creation.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

ean.description: Optional EAN to attach after SKU creation.

isActive.description: Whether the SKU should be created as active. VTEX recommends false during creation.

activateIfPossible.description: Whether VTEX should auto-activate the SKU when an image or active component exists.

commercialConditionId.description: Commercial condition ID. Use vtex_commercial_conditions to inspect available condition IDs and vtex_payment_rules to configure linked installment/payment behavior.

tools.name: vtex_commercial_conditions
tools.description: Read VTEX commercial conditions through one action-based tool: list available condition records or get a specific condition used by checkout and installment strategies. VTEX Catalog API only exposes read-only GET endpoints for commercial conditions, so they cannot be created or modified through this API and new conditions must be created manually in the VTEX admin panel.

action.description: Action to perform for VTEX commercial conditions.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use for this operation.

search.description: Optional text filter for condition name lookup.

tools.name: vtex_payment_rules
tools.description: Manage VTEX payment rules through one action-based tool: list, get, create, update, or delete rules that map installments, payment systems, and optional commercial-condition restrictions. Delete operations require confirmed=true and can immediately remove installment options from checkout.

action.description: Action to perform for VTEX payment rules.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use for this operation.

commercialConditionId.description: Commercial condition identifier linked to this payment rule.

restrictedByCondition.description: Whether checkout should restrict this rule to the linked commercial condition.

installments.description: Installment configuration rows for the payment rule.

confirmed.description: Set to true only after the assistant has explained the impact of this operation and the user has explicitly confirmed they want to proceed.

tools.name: vtex_get_brand
tools.description: Get one VTEX catalog brand by ID.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_create_brand
tools.description: Create one brand in VTEX Catalog using the official brand contract. This creates the brand record and returns the created brand payload.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

id.description: Brand ID required by VTEX Catalog API.

active.description: Whether the brand should be active.

menuHome.description: Whether the brand should appear in the home menu.

tools.name: vtex_update_brand
tools.description: Update selected fields on one VTEX catalog brand. Only the provided fields are changed; the tool keeps the current VTEX values for the rest.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

active.description: Whether the brand should remain active.

menuHome.description: Whether the brand should appear in the home menu.

tools.name: vtex_list_specification_groups
tools.description: List VTEX specification groups available for one category, optionally filtered by group name. Use this to discover a real field group before creating mock-only specifications.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

categoryId.description: VTEX category ID used to discover specification groups.

nameContains.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter applied to specification group names.

tools.name: vtex_get_product_specifications
tools.description: Get all specifications currently associated with one VTEX catalog product.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_create_category
tools.description: Create one category in VTEX Catalog. This writes a new category record and can be used for top-level or child categories depending on fatherCategoryId.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

id.description: Optional category ID. VTEX can generate it.

fatherCategoryId.description: Parent category ID. Use null for a top-level category.

stockKeepingUnitSelectionMode.description: How shoppers should choose SKUs in storefront.

showInStoreFront.description: Whether the category should appear in menus.

isActive.description: Whether the category should be active.

activeStoreFrontLink.description: Whether the category link should be active in storefront.

showBrandFilter.description: Whether the category page should show brand filters.

tools.name: vtex_update_category
tools.description: Update selected visible fields on one VTEX category, including activation through isActive. Use this tool for visible fields only, not hierarchy changes.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

categoryId.description: VTEX category ID to update. Use this tool for visible fields only, not hierarchy changes.

isActive.description: Whether the category should be active.

tools.name: vtex_move_category
tools.description: Move one VTEX category under a different parent by changing only its hierarchy. Experimental/high-risk: VTEX officially warns that direct category-tree moves can be risky and may leave catalog inconsistencies. Supports preview/apply confirmation guardrails.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

categoryId.description: VTEX category ID to move. Experimental/high-risk: VTEX officially warns that direct category-tree moves can be risky and may leave catalog inconsistencies.

targetParentId.description: Target parent category ID for hierarchy changes only. Use 0 for a root-level category when supported by the account. Prefer preview first because VTEX documents direct tree moves as risky.

mode.description: Preview the experimental move or apply it after explicit confirmation. Preview is strongly recommended because VTEX warns against direct category-tree moves.

confirmed.description: Set to true only after the assistant has explained the impact of this operation and the user has explicitly confirmed they want to proceed.

confirmationNote.description: Optional note summarizing the user's explicit confirmation in natural language.

tools.name: vtex_create_specification
tools.description: Create one specification field in VTEX Catalog, including its field type, group, and visibility flags.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

isFilter.description: Whether the specification should act as a filter.

isOnProductDetails.description: Whether the specification should appear on product details.

isStockKeepingUnit.description: Whether this is an SKU specification.

tools.name: vtex_create_specification_value
tools.description: Create one specification value for an existing VTEX specification field.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

isActive.description: Whether the value should be active.

tools.name: vtex_associate_specification
tools.description: Associate one specification to one product or one SKU. This writes a single specification association using either a fieldValueId or raw text, depending on the field type.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

entityType.description: Whether the specification should be associated to a product or an SKU.

resourceId.description: Product ID or SKU ID depending on entityType.

fieldValueId.description: Specification value ID. Required for combo, radio, and checkbox fields.

text.description: Raw text value. Use for free text specifications instead of fieldValueId.

tools.name: vtex_delete_product_specification
tools.description: Delete one specification association from one VTEX catalog product using the productId and the association/spec record ID (`Id` from `vtex_get_product_specifications`), not the field ID.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

specificationId.description: Product-specification association ID (`Id` from `vtex_get_product_specifications`). This is the spec record ID used by VTEX delete/update, not the field ID.

tools.name: vtex_delete_all_product_specifications
tools.description: Delete all specification associations from one VTEX catalog product. This is high-risk and requires explicit confirmation before execution.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

confirmed.description: Set to true only after the assistant has explained the impact of this operation and the user has explicitly confirmed they want to proceed.

confirmationNote.description: Optional note summarizing the user's explicit confirmation in natural language.

tools.name: vtex_delete_brand
tools.description: Delete one VTEX catalog brand by ID. The caller must already know the brandId because this tool performs no pre-delete lookup or readback.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

brandId.description: VTEX brand ID. The caller must already know this ID; no pre-delete lookup is performed.

tools.name: vtex_delete_catalog_image
tools.description: Delete one catalog image from a VTEX SKU by imageId. The caller must already know the imageId, typically from vtex_get_sku_images, because this tool performs no pre-delete lookup or readback.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

imageId.description: Image identifier to delete. The caller must already know this ID; no pre-delete lookup is performed.

tools.name: vtex_delete_sku_specification
tools.description: Delete one specification association from one VTEX catalog SKU using the skuId and specificationId. This tool performs no pre-delete lookup or readback.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

specificationId.description: Specification field ID to remove from the SKU.

tools.name: vtex_delete_all_sku_specifications
tools.description: Delete all specification associations from one VTEX catalog SKU. This is high-risk, requires explicit confirmation, and performs no pre-delete lookup or readback.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

confirmed.description: Set to true only after the assistant has explained the impact of this operation and the user has explicitly confirmed they want to proceed.

confirmationNote.description: Optional note summarizing the user's explicit confirmation in natural language.

tools.name: vtex_attach_catalog_image
tools.description: Attach one catalog image to one SKU using a public image URL. This adds a new SKU file entry in VTEX Catalog.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_update_product_brand
tools.description: Update the brand assignment of one VTEX Catalog product. Changes the brand identifier the product is associated with.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

brandId.description: Brand identifier to set on the product.

tools.name: vtex_add_sku_ean
tools.description: Append one EAN value to a VTEX SKU. This adds a new EAN to the existing set without replacing other EANs already assigned to the SKU.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_replace_sku_eans
tools.description: Replace the entire set of EAN values on a VTEX SKU with a new list. All previously assigned EANs for the SKU are removed and the provided values become the only ones.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

eans.description: Complete list of EANs to keep in VTEX.

tools.name: vtex_get_sku_images
tools.description: List all images currently attached to a VTEX SKU. Returns image identifiers, URLs, alt text, labels, and order position for each image.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_update_catalog_image
tools.description: Update an existing catalog image on a VTEX SKU identified by the image identifier. Use to change the URL, alt text, label, or display position of an image already attached to the SKU.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel one order in VTEX Orders API. Before using this tool, the assistant must explain what will be canceled, mention that invoiced orders cannot be canceled and cancellations cannot be reversed, and obtain explicit confirmation from the user. Only then should the tool be called with confirmed=true.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

confirmed.description: Set to true only after the assistant has explained the impact of this operation and the user has explicitly confirmed they want to proceed.

reason.description: Reason for canceling the order. VTEX persists this reason.

confirmationNote.description: Optional note summarizing the user's explicit confirmation in natural language.

tools.name: vtex_invoice_order
tools.description: Invoice one order in VTEX Orders API. Before using this tool, the assistant must explain that invoicing changes the order's logistics and financial state, mention that the tool writes invoice data into VTEX, and obtain explicit confirmation from the user. Only then should the tool be called with confirmed=true.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

confirmed.description: Set to true only after the assistant has explained the impact of this operation and the user has explicitly confirmed they want to proceed.

confirmationNote.description: Optional note summarizing the user's explicit confirmation in natural language.

invoiceValue.description: Invoice total in cents, represented as a string without decimal separator.

price.description: Unit price in cents, without decimal separator.

description.description: Optional extra description for this line.

invoiceOrderNumber.description: Optional order number from merchant ERP.

tools.name: vtex_add_order_tracking
tools.description: Add tracking data to one invoiced order in VTEX. Before using this tool, the assistant must explain which invoice and tracking data will be updated, mention that this affects the operational communication sent to the customer, and obtain explicit confirmation from the user. Only then should the tool be called with confirmed=true.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number that will receive tracking data.

confirmed.description: Set to true only after the assistant has explained the impact of this operation and the user has explicitly confirmed they want to proceed.

confirmationNote.description: Optional note summarizing the user's explicit confirmation in natural language.

isDelivered.description: Optional delivery status to send to VTEX tracking timeline.

deliveredDate.description: Optional delivered date in `yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm` format.

tools.name: vtex_get_sku_price
tools.description: Get base pricing information for one SKU.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_get_computed_price
tools.description: Get computed SKU price by price table context.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

priceTableId.description: Price table or trade policy identifier

tools.name: vtex_get_product_offers
tools.description: Get offers for all SKUs under a product.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_get_sku_offers
tools.description: Get offers for a specific SKU under a product.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_get_category_tree
tools.description: Get the VTEX catalog category tree for a profile with an optional depth limit.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

depth.description: Tree depth from 1 to 5. Defaults to 5.

tools.name: vtex_list_categories
tools.description: List VTEX catalog categories using compact rows and pagination metadata.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_get_category
tools.description: Get one VTEX catalog category by ID.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_list_brands
tools.description: List VTEX catalog brands using compact rows and pagination metadata.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_get_product
tools.description: Get one VTEX catalog product by ID.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_get_sku
tools.description: Get one VTEX catalog SKU by ID.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_list_products
tools.description: List VTEX catalog product IDs with compact rows, pagination metadata, and optional keyword search.

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.

tools.name: vtex_list_products_by_category
tools.description: List VTEX catalog products for one category using compact rows and pagination metadata (VTEX caps this endpoint at 50 items per page).

profileId.description: Explicit VTEX profile id to use. If omitted, the tool returns a guided selection payload with available active profiles.
